author: Family Life OS local release validation

statements.impact_statement: pip 26.3 retains only pkg_resources from setuptools. setuptools and the vulnerable setuptools/package_index.py are absent from the candidate image. scripts/check_pip_vendor_surface.py verifies these conditions before CI scanning. This statement does not cover an independently installed setuptools or another pip version. See the pip vendoring policy and GHSA-5rjg-fvgr-3xxf.
